argument: The central impulse has M singular values u/M. Adding the rank-r approximant can remove at most r such directions. The baseline approximation error shifts each singular value by at most tau. Thus sigma_(M-r)>=u/M-tau>0, while the retained count above the fixed threshold is certified asr.
scope: Does not assert that the baseline exact rank was1893, or that algebraic rank changed between the two encoded records.
